title: Leveraging Weakly Annotated Data for Hate Speech Detection in Code-Mixed Hinglish: A Feasibility-Driven Transfer Learning Approach with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of Large Language Models for hate speech detection in a code-mixed language. Although it uses classification labels such as 'Religion-based' and 'Moral Policing' to categorize misogynistic content, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious frameworks, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems themselves.
